blocks.en: GEMS Taiwan is a five-year-old team based in Taipei, Taiwan. With two top 10 projects and a Grand Prize, the team is filled with ambition for this year's project as well. Noticing the struggles small farmers encounter when planting crops, such as osmotic, heat, and salinity stress, our team wants to alleviate these concerns through iGEM. Through our education program to other schools, we plan to educate students about the common stresses farmers can face during the year and how crops relate to our daily lives. Our education program plans to target elementary, middle, and high school students.

blocks.zh: GEMS Taiwan 是一支位於臺灣臺北、已成立五年的隊伍。在拿下兩個前十名的成績與一次大獎之後，我們對今年的計畫依然充滿抱負。有鑑於小農在種植作物時面臨的種種挑戰，如滲透壓、高溫與鹽分逆境，我們希望能透過 iGEM 減緩這些困境。藉由推廣至各校的教育計畫，我們將讓學生認識農民一年中常見的逆境，以及農作物與日常生活的關係。教育計畫的對象涵蓋國小、國中及高中學生。

blocks.zh: 嗨，我是 Renee！！！^^ 我喜歡各種類型的音樂、書籍和遊戲。我加入 iGEM 是因為想從事一個能讓我深入學習生物學（我最喜歡的科目之一）的計畫。

blocks.en: Hi, I'm Sophia! I love tennis, traveling, and exploring nature! I have always been passionate about biology, and I'm looking forward to learning and exploring more about this subject through iGEM!
blocks.text: Hi, I'm Sophia! I love tennis, traveling, and exploring nature! I have always been passionate about biology, and I'm looking forward to learning and exploring more about this subject through iGEM!
blocks.zh: 嗨，我是 Sophia！我喜歡打網球、旅遊和親近大自然！我一直對生物學充滿熱情，很期待能透過 iGEM 學習和探索更多這個領域的知識！

blocks.en: Hi, I'm Caden, and I'm an advisor for GEMS Taiwan. Following a great year as a drylab member from the 2025 team, I decided to return as an advisor to support the team any way possible by sharing my knowledge and experience.
blocks.text: Hi, I'm Caden, and I'm an advisor for GEMS Taiwan. Following a great year as a drylab member from the 2025 team, I decided to return as an advisor to support the team any way possible by sharing my knowledge and experience.
blocks.zh: 嗨，我是 Caden，是 GEMS Taiwan 的顧問。繼在 2025 年隊伍擔任Drylab成員的精彩一年後，我決定以顧問身份回歸，盡可能地透過分享知識與經驗來支持隊伍。

blocks.en: Hi, I'm Dylan. I joined the iGEM team as an advisor because I'm genuinely interested in synthetic biology and enjoy working on projects that connect engineering and biology. I'm looking forward to supporting the team, learning from the process, and helping refine the science behind the project as it develops.
blocks.text: Hi, I'm Dylan. I joined the iGEM team as an advisor because I'm genuinely interested in synthetic biology and enjoy working on projects that connect engineering and biology. I'm looking forward to supporting the team, learning from the process, and helping refine the science behind the project as it develops.
blocks.zh: 嗨，我是 Dylan。我以顧問的身份加入 iGEM 隊伍，因為我真的對合成生物學很感興趣，也喜歡參與連結工程與生物學的計畫。我很期待能支持隊伍、從過程中學習，並幫助深化計畫背後的科學依據。

blocks.en: Hi, I’m Elizabeth (Eli) and I am a rising junior at Taipei American school. Other than scientific research I also enjoy dancing. I hope to take my past experience with syn bio to support the next gemstaiwan team.
blocks.text: Hi, I’m Elizabeth (Eli) and I am a rising junior at Taipei American school. Other than scientific research I also enjoy dancing. I hope to take my past experience with syn bio to support the next gemstaiwan team.
blocks.zh: 嗨，我是 Elizabeth（Eli），Taipei American School 即將升高三的學生。除了科學研究之外，我也喜歡跳舞。我希望能運用過去在合成生物學的經驗，支持下一屆的 GEMS Taiwan 隊伍。

blocks.en: Hi, I'm Hachi, I was the project lead and wet-lab lead for Gems Taiwan 2025. My passion for synthetic biology has driven me to pursue iGEM for another round, but as an advisor to share experiences with new iGEMers. I look forward to supporting and working with the team, and build a meaningful project.
blocks.text: Hi, I'm Hachi, I was the project lead and wet-lab lead for Gems Taiwan 2025. My passion for synthetic biology has driven me to pursue iGEM for another round, but as an advisor to share experiences with new iGEMers. I look forward to supporting and working with the team, and build a meaningful project.
blocks.zh: 嗨，我是 Hachi，我是 Gems Taiwan 2025 的專案負責人和Wetlab負責人。對合成生物學的熱忱驅使我再次參與 iGEM，這次以顧問的身份與新成員分享經驗。我期待能支持並與隊伍合作，共同打造一個有意義的計畫。

blocks.en: Hi! I'm Ian, and I'm an advisor this year. I'm passionate about ecology and zoology, and I bring that same passion to synthetic biology as well. I hope to support the team through my wet lab knowledge, as well as my artistic ability.
blocks.text: Hi! I'm Ian, and I'm an advisor this year. I'm passionate about ecology and zoology, and I bring that same passion to synthetic biology as well. I hope to support the team through my wet lab knowledge, as well as my artistic ability.
blocks.zh: 嗨！我是 Ian，今年擔任顧問。我對生態學和動物學充滿熱情，並將這份熱情帶入合成生物學。我希望能透過Wetlab的知識以及我的藝術能力來支持隊伍。

blocks.en: Hi, I’m Katherine. After being a drylab member on the 2025 team, I wanted to return to support the next group. I’m excited to work with the team again.
blocks.text: Hi, I’m Katherine. After being a drylab member on the 2025 team, I wanted to return to support the next group. I’m excited to work with the team again.
blocks.zh: 嗨，我是 Katherine。在 2025 年隊伍擔任 Drylab 成員之後，我想回來支持下一屆的夥伴。很期待能再次和隊伍一起合作。

blocks.en: Hi I am Oscar a Sophmore at TAS and a current advisor for GEMS Taiwan. I was a former drylab member for the 2025 team, and I hope to bring meaningful impact to the team from what I have learned last year. I also hope to continue looking forward to the learning opportunities that Igem has to offer, whether that's teamwork or technical skills.
blocks.text: Hi I am Oscar a Sophmore at TAS and a current advisor for GEMS Taiwan. I was a former drylab member for the 2025 team, and I hope to bring meaningful impact to the team from what I have learned last year. I also hope to continue looking forward to the learning opportunities that Igem has to offer, whether that's teamwork or technical skills.
blocks.zh: 嗨，我是 Oscar，TAS 的高二學生，也是 GEMS Taiwan 現任 advisor。我曾是 2025 年隊伍的 Drylab 成員，希望能將去年所學帶給隊伍，創造有意義的影響。我也期待繼續把握 iGEM 所提供的各種學習機會，無論是團隊合作還是專業技能。

blocks.en: Hi! I'm Venus, a former member of the 2025 Gems Taiwan iGEM team. After an amazing experience last year and because of my passion for biology, I chose to return as an advisor to support the 2026 team, share wet lab experience, and continue exploring the impact of synthetic biology.
blocks.text: Hi! I'm Venus, a former member of the 2025 Gems Taiwan iGEM team. After an amazing experience last year and because of my passion for biology, I chose to return as an advisor to support the 2026 team, share wet lab experience, and continue exploring the impact of synthetic biology.
blocks.zh: 嗨！我是 Venus，2025 年 Gems Taiwan iGEM 隊伍的舊成員。在去年的精彩經歷以及對生物學的熱情驅使下，我選擇以顧問的身份回歸，支持 2026 年的隊伍、分享Wetlab經驗，並繼續探索合成生物學的影響力。

blocks.en: Chars Hsieh, an experienced researcher with over ten years of expertise in molecular and cell biology. I train and empower students at GEMS Academy, journeying with them to explore the frontiers of synthetic biology.
blocks.text: Chars Hsieh, an experienced researcher with over ten years of expertise in molecular and cell biology. I train and empower students at GEMS Academy, journeying with them to explore the frontiers of synthetic biology.
blocks.zh: Chars，擁有逾十年分子與細胞生物學研究經驗的資深研究員。我在 GEMS Academy 培育並賦能學生，與他們一同探索合成生物學的前沿。

blocks.en: Hey everyone, I'm Gabriel, wet lab instructor. I'll be guiding the biology experiments this year. Looking forward to learning a lot together over the coming months!
blocks.text: Hey everyone, I'm Gabriel, wet lab instructor. I'll be guiding the biology experiments this year. Looking forward to learning a lot together over the coming months!
blocks.zh: 大家好，我是 Gabriel，Wetlab 指導老師。今年我將引導生物學實驗，期待未來幾個月能和大家一起學習很多東西！

blocks.en: Hi, this is Gina, one of the wetlab instructors. I am passionate about science and have extensive hands-on experience working in the lab. I also enjoy guiding students in hands-on experiments.
blocks.text: Hi, this is Gina, one of the wetlab instructors. I am passionate about science and have extensive hands-on experience working in the lab. I also enjoy guiding students in hands-on experiments.
blocks.zh: 嗨，我是 Gina，Wetlab 指導老師之一。我對科學充滿熱情，有豐富的實驗室實作經驗，也很享受帶領學生進行動手操作的實驗。

blocks.en: Hello! I am Jessie, HP instructor. I've spent years teaching Chemistry and guiding various science projects. I enjoyed so much seeing students apply what they've learned to the real world! Can't wait to see the impact this year's iGEM team will have on society!
blocks.text: Hello! I am Jessie, HP instructor. I've spent years teaching Chemistry and guiding various science projects. I enjoyed so much seeing students apply what they've learned to the real world! Can't wait to see the impact this year's iGEM team will have on society!
blocks.zh: 哈囉！我是 Jessie，HP 指導老師。多年來我致力於教授化學並帶領各種科學計畫。看到學生將所學應用於現實世界讓我非常有成就感，非常期待看到今年 iGEM 隊伍對社會所帶來的影響！

blocks.en: Timmy the drylab instructor here. This year we put plants under stress and watch who breaks first: sometimes it's the system, sometimes it's us. That's fine. Not everything survives hardships. But often times that's how you find the gems.
blocks.text: Timmy the drylab instructor here. This year we put plants under stress and watch who breaks first: sometimes it's the system, sometimes it's us. That's fine. Not everything survives hardships. But often times that's how you find the gems.
blocks.zh: 我是Drylab 指導老師 Timmy。今年我們讓植物承受逆境，看看誰先撐不住：有時是系統，有時是我們自己。沒關係。不是所有事物都能熬過逆境。但往往就是在這個過程中，才能找到真正的珍寶。
